title: SpaceX stock down again, shaving off some IPO gains; confirms debt offering
title_zh: SpaceX 股价再次下跌，削减了部分 IPO 收益；确认发债
summary: SpaceX stock fell again on Monday, now poised for three straight down days after a massive run-up following its IPO earlier this month. SpaceX also confirmed its first-ever bond issuance in a filing.
summary_zh: SpaceX 股价周一再次下跌，继本月初首次公开募股后大幅上涨后，目前已连续三天下跌。 SpaceX还在一份文件中确认了其首次债券发行。

title: Iran War Puts $124 Billion Gulf Remittance Lifeline at Risk
title_zh: 伊朗战争使 1240 亿美元的海湾汇款生命线面临风险
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Steve Geoffrey, one of roughly 30 million foreign nationals in the Middle East, considers himself lucky to still be able to support his family in Kenya.Most Read from BloombergIran Says Hormuz Closed Again as Talks With US Set to OpenUS and Iran Make ‘Progress’ ...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——史蒂夫·杰弗里（Steve Geoffrey）是中东约 3000 万外国人中的一员，他认为自己很幸运，仍然能够养活自己在肯尼亚的家人。彭博社伊朗的大多数报道称，霍尔木兹海峡再次关闭，因为与美国的谈判即将开放美国和伊朗取得“进展”......

title: Meta's WhatsApp to be led by Indian startup founder Kunal Shah
title_zh: Meta 旗下 WhatsApp 将由印度初创公司创始人 Kunal Shah 领导
summary: BANGALORE, June 22 - Indian fintech firm CRED's founder Kunal Shah will become Meta-owned WhatsApp's new leader, the messaging app's current head Will Cathcart said on Monday in a post on X.
summary_zh: 班加罗尔，6 月 22 日 - 印度金融科技公司 CRED 的创始人 Kunal Shah 将成为 Meta 旗下 WhatsApp 的新领导者，WhatsApp 现任负责人 Will Cathcart 周一在 X 上发帖表示。

title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella warns of AI concentration risks
title_zh: 微软首席执行官萨蒂亚纳德拉警告人工智能集中风险
summary: In an interview with the Wall Street Journal, Microsoft (MSFT) CEO Satya Nadella warned of the growing concentration in the handful of artificial intelligence companies leading the AI boom.
summary_zh: 微软（MSFT）首席执行官萨提亚·纳德拉（Satya Nadella）在接受《华尔街日报》采访时警告称，引领人工智能热潮的少数人工智能公司正日益集中在其中。

title: Indian fintech firm CRED to raise $900 million from Meta at $4.5 billion valuation
title_zh: 印度金融科技公司 CRED 将从 Meta 融资 9 亿美元，估值 45 亿美元
summary: Indian ‌fintech firm ‌CRED said ​on Monday it will raise ‌about $900 ⁠million from Meta Platforms ⁠at a ​post-money ​valuation ​of $4.5 billion, ‌as it seeks to accelerate growth ‌and ​prepare ​for ​an eventual ‌stock market ​listing.
summary_zh: 印度金融科技公司 CRED 周一表示，它将以 45 亿美元的投后估值从 Meta Platforms 筹集约 9 亿美元，以寻求加速增长并为最终的股票市场上市做准备。

title: Meta Taps New WhatsApp Boss as Part of $900 Million Investment
title_zh: Meta 任命 WhatsApp 新任老板作为 9 亿美元投资的一部分

title: Amazon Prime Day to gauge US consumer strain as focus shifts to basics
title_zh: 亚马逊 Prime Day 衡量美国消费者压力，焦点转向基础商品
summary: Amazon Prime Day starting on Tuesday will be a litmus test of U.S. shoppers' spending power, with the earlier-than-usual sales event increasingly centered on perishable groceries, household basics and back-to-school needs ‌rather than carefree splurges.
summary_zh: 周二开始的亚马逊 Prime Day 将成为对美国购物者消费能力的试金石，比平常更早的销售活动越来越多地集中在易腐烂的杂货、家庭基本用品和返校需求上，而不是无忧无虑的挥霍。

title: Micron earnings, PCE data, gas prices: What to watch this week
title_zh: 美光财报、PCE 数据、天然气价格：本周值得关注的内容
summary: Micron earnings and PCE data headline a busy week for investors.
summary_zh: 美光财报和 PCE 数据是投资者忙碌的一周的头条新闻。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500 rise, Nasdaq wavers with peace talks, AI demand in focus
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标普 500 指数上涨，纳斯达克因和谈而动摇，人工智能需求成为焦点
summary: Investors assessed progress in US-Iran peace talks and prepared for a pivotal inflation report later this week.
summary_zh: 投资者评估了美伊和平谈判的进展，并为本周晚些时候发布的关键通胀报告做准备。
